title: Cu CMP slurry delivery degradation
content: Symptom: Slurry flow decline, removal-rate loss, endpoint extension, Cu residue, leakage short. Root cause: Slurry delivery degradation reduced Cu CMP removal rate. Actions: Inspect slurry pump, replace slurry filter, calibrate flow controller, run qualification wafers.

title: Isolated single-Wafer scratch investigation
content: Symptom: One Wafer has an isolated scratch while adjacent Wafers and equipment FDC are normal. Root cause: Transient particle or handling event; exact source was not confirmed. Actions: Inspect handling path, review particle monitors, inspect carrier, monitor subsequent Lots.

title: ILD deposition chamber rate excursion
content: Symptom: Even Wafers have low pre-CMP and post-CMP thickness with normal CMP FDC. Root cause: CVD_ILD_01_CH02 deposition rate excursion. Actions: Hold CVD chamber, verify deposition rate, calibrate gas delivery, run thickness qualification.
